notes.title: Atmospheric Update Now Available
notes.content:
G'Day from the Land Downunder,

We are super excited to bring you the [b]Atmospheric Update[/b] for Laser Z.  It's taken a few weeks longer to complete, but we are pumped with the results.

Early versions of Laser Z used a very low poly neon retro look to ensure performance didn't suffer.  As we progressed on the Early Access journey we made several significant changes to the underlying game calculations to improve performance.

This allowed us to focus more on the look and feel of the game and to create worlds and levels that are more engaging and immersive.

We are now hard at work on the next update which will feature:
[list]
[*] New World 7 in World mode with 10 new levels.
[*] Introduction of the new Boss - Orange Boss!
[*] A new survival mode featuring only Bosses!
[/list]


Updates in this release:
[list]
[*] Completely new look and feel for World Game, Survival Mode and Defender Mode
[*] Previous Gunslinger Mode and Party Mode merged into a single Survival Mode
[*] Performance updates in game mechanics to give a smoother experience
[*] Additional tweaks to Defender Mode, making the challenge ramp up quicker
[*] Menu selection now features audio feedback to confirm selections
[/list]

notes.title: Atmospheric Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Howdy All,

IT's been a little bit since our last update and we wanted to let y'all know about the upcoming [b]Atmospheric Update[/b] for Laser Z.

Our intention had been to release the latest world - World 7 - in World Progression mode.  While this is still in development, we've accelerated our plans around the vibe of the game.

Up until now we've been using an 80's retro look for early testing to allow us to develop enough the of the level engine to have a good read on performance.   We are pretty happy with performance and now have the headroom to increase and improve the visual effects and imagery of the game.

We don't have a firm release date yet but we are targeting the next 3-4 weeks for the release.

In the mean time we'd like to share some screen shots of the new visuals.

notes.title: Laser Z 0.1.5 Released
notes.content:
It's been a little while since our last update but finally we are ready with World 6 - Ring of Fire.  This world contains some of our most creative and challenging levels requiring us to spend extra time to get them right.

This update brings the total number of levels in World Mode to 58.


Updates in this release:
[list]
[*] World 6 with 10 all new levels
[*] Introduction of the first Power Down - Instant Death
[*] A new boss - Green Boss - to battle with
[*] New music for World 4
[*] Defender Mode has been tweaked to make it more challenging and fun!
[/list]


Bug fixes in this release:
[list]
[*] The freezing between screen transitions has been fixed.  
[/list]

notes.title: Laser Z 0.1.3 Update - Happy New Year
notes.content:
Just in time for the New Year, Laser Z 0.1.3 adds a whole new world - World 5 - to World Mode.

Introducing new cubes types - fading and disappearing - to the existing stable of stop and go cubes, cubes from four directions and Power Ups, World 5 steps up the challenge level.

Progress through 10 levels to see if you've got what it takes to beat World 5.

We have stepped up the difficulty on this world so your feedback as always is really important.

We are currently working on the following for the next update:
[list]
[*] World 6 - introduces the concept of the Power Down - these levels will make you sweat
[*] Improving transition between scenes to reduce the freezing effect.
[/list]

We are still early in the Early Access path (pardon the pun :-) ) and your feedback on shaping the direction and content of Laser Z is really appreciated.
